snippet.title: Tactics Returners | New Extended Gameplay Clip!
snippet.description:
Here is new updated gameplay footage showcasing our current build!

Tactics Returners is an Indie developed passion project. Just following/liking our video means a lot to us, as we are just finally getting to a point where more of the game is realized, and we can start to show more media behind our project!

https://www.tacticsreturners.com/
